requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
A/P:
1. Weight gain / BMI 25.5 — wants a structured plan. Starting today:
 - Reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1500 kcal/day, food logging in a phone app.
 - Water aerobics / lap swimming at the Y, 4 times a week.
 - Enrolled in the clinic's Healthy Weight lifestyle program; RD intake to follow.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Migraine — ~2/month, sumatriptan effective.
3. Eczema — stable.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 12/27/2025
Healthy Weight program intake. 4-day food log: regular meals; frequent grazing on crackers/granola bars while working; wine 3–4 nights/week.
Plan: ~1500 kcal/day logged in phone app; set snack times (10 AM, 3 PM); keep snacks out of the workspace; wine limited to 2 nights/week.
Activity: lap swimming / water aerobics 4x/week.
RD follow-up in ~6 weeks.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 05/17/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, averaging ~1500–1600 kcal. Snacking now scheduled.
Adjustments: add protein to afternoon snack, lighter weekend brunches.
Reports she keeps up with swimming 4x/week.
Continue program; next visit ~2–3 months.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/11/2026
S: Weight follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program visits since December — logging meals, swimming regularly. Frustrated: weight 71.7 kg today vs 73.6 kg when the plan began (-2.6%), no change since spring despite reported adherence. Asks about medication; a friend is on Wegovy. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. On OCP.
O: Wt 71.7 kg, BMI 24.8. BP 116/72.

A/P:
1. Weight management, BMI 24.8 — patient strongly prefers to try medication. Plan: start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects. Continue diet and swimming. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Migraine — stable.
